highlights: Put something up: say the size of each container, where the produce came from, Raw or In oil, and How dry for dried food; canning methods show a short note from published home-canning advice
As is and Fresh, as picked items can record how much and where they're from, and both can be changed later in Edit
Places: Edit places on the Pantry renames a place, changes its kind, or deletes an empty one; a new Fridge freezer kind
The name search lists crops and varieties too, best matches first, and tells plantings with the same name apart by wave and sown date
A planting's page opens Put something up right there, with Undo
A jar's Edit asks the door's questions, shows Discard by on every method, and can correct where it's from
One bag sized in lb, oz or kg now reads back in that unit on the Pantry (about 1 lb left), not in grams
Fixes: a retry no longer uses up two; a recipe edit keeps a line's details; a batch started in the evening shows the right day; Put it up keeps a typed name when you close its details
